description: Before spending credits, call quote_generation and explain the returned price or unknown total. For a known quote, obtain approval and pass max_credits. For an unknown total, obtain explicit acceptance and pass accept_unknown_cost:true without max_credits. Never switch consent modes or remove or raise a ceiling without new user approval. Agents charge per stage; no whole-run spending cap is enforced. Supply the intended tool and its planned input parameters. Reads current Freebeat pricing rules, without starting or charging for generation. Quoted credits are list price before account discounts or allowances. Unavailable means unknown, never free; agent totals depend on stages and retries. For music, check list_music_models for length control before quoting.

parameters.description: The same input parameters planned for the paid tool, including the model, prompt, duration, and other price-changing options.

name: quote_generation
